headline: State AGs challenge Character.AI's plan to auction user chats
summary: State attorneys general are challenging Character.AI's plan to sell users' private chat data as part of its bankruptcy sale, which officials say includes data from more than 21 million US accounts, including 2.1 million minors, and explicit conversations with children.
